items.purpose: Windrose tools hub for recipes, progression, resources, ship comparison, and dedicated server setup. Built for fast planning and Google SEO.

faq.question: Does Windrose Guides have interactive tools?
faq.answer: The current tools are static, crawlable planning pages. Interactive filters can be added later without changing the URLs.

faq.question: Why add tools before more articles?
faq.answer: Tools attract repeated visits and earn links because they solve a player task faster than a long article.

items.name: Windrose Progression Checklist
items.notes: Migrated from existing HTML snapshot. Needs structured verification during phase two.
items.purpose: Step-by-step Windrose progression checklist from bonfire and workbench to copper tools, first ship, crew rescue, and Foothills.

faq.question: Should I build a permanent base early?
faq.answer: No. A small camp near resources is more efficient until you understand the island layout and unlock better tools.

faq.question: What should I carry before leaving the first island?
faq.answer: Bring bandages, food, repair materials, copper tools, and enough wood or stone to rebuild basic stations.

items.name: Windrose Recipe Finder
items.notes: Migrated from existing HTML snapshot. Needs structured verification during phase two.
items.purpose: Find Windrose recipes fast: workbench level, materials, progression use, bags, bullets, repair kits, tools, and copper or iron unlocks.

faq.question: What is the most important early recipe?
faq.answer: Stone Pickaxe is the key early recipe because it starts copper and clay progression.

faq.question: Which recipe increases inventory space?
faq.answer: Torn Sailcloth Bag is the first storage upgrade, followed later by Sailor Backpack and Bosun Backpack.

faq.question: Where are the full recipes?
faq.answer: Use the Workbench Recipes , Smelting , and crafting subcategory pages.

items.name: Windrose Resource Planner
items.notes: Migrated from existing HTML snapshot. Needs structured verification during phase two.
items.purpose: Plan Windrose resource farming by tool gate, location, and crafting use. Covers copper, iron, clay, gunpowder, sulfur, wood, stone, and fiber.

faq.question: What resource should I farm first?
faq.answer: Wood and stone are first, but copper and clay are the first real progression resources.

faq.question: Where should I farm gunpowder early?
faq.answer: Use smuggler stashes and pirate camps before you can craft gunpowder from sulfur and ash.

items.name: Windrose Ship Selector
items.notes: Migrated from existing HTML snapshot. Needs structured verification during phase two.
items.purpose: Compare Windrose ships by speed, handling, firepower, durability, solo play, and co-op roles. Choose Sloop, Brigantine, or Frigate.

faq.question: What is the best solo ship?
faq.answer: The Sloop is the easiest solo ship because speed and turning matter more when you do not have a full crew.

faq.question: What is the best general ship?
faq.answer: The Brigantine is the best default recommendation because it balances speed, firepower, and survival.
